data.action: 擦亮最后一只杯子，检查杯沿后放回架上。
data.description: 打烊后换上藏蓝清洁连体服，栞那站在咖啡馆水槽边，用干净布巾擦亮最后一只杯子。她听见杯碟轻碰的声音，停下来确认杯沿，再带着轻松笑意把它放回架上。
data.promptProse: After closing, Kanna stands beside the cafe sink in a navy utility jumpsuit with rolled cuffs and a pale-gray waist apron, polishing the last cup with a clean cloth. Hearing dishes touch, she checks its rim before returning it to the rack with a relaxed smile. The medium view includes sink and rack together. Soft counter light catches the porcelain edge and damp metal, leaving gentle shadows beneath her wiping hands.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 打烊后的杯碟轻响
